# `plan`

> Profile: deferred · Permission key: `[permission] plan`

Enter or exit planning mode (read-only, no file modifications)

Deferred tools are not advertised on every request. Activate one with `tool_search` or set `session.tool_profile = "full"`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `action` | one of `enter`, `exit` | yes | Whether to enter or exit planning mode |
